_comment: 10 Player Power cards (Upgrade Pack). Coloured = the 5 base characters matching player-board colours; grey = 5 extra characters usable with any colour. Back side = flavour story only. Text verbatim from cards.

powers.name: Mr. Bones
powers.title: The Boss
powers.text: You start with 1 Gas Can. You treat all City tiles as if they had Helipads. You only have 2 MP each turn.

powers.name: Ruby
powers.title: Hacker
powers.text: You can enter a closed Business without using a key. Gain 2 Notoriety each time you do this.

powers.name: Vinnie
powers.title: Explosives
powers.text: You can open Lockers without using a key. Gain 1 Notoriety each time you take a Locker tile.

powers.name: Claws
powers.title: Safe Expert
powers.text: When you draw Exit or Locker tiles, you may draw 1 or 2 extra tiles to choose from. For each extra tile you draw, you must pay $2k.

powers.name: Scar
powers.title: Driver
powers.text: During the Avoid step, you may pay $2k and discard a Gas Can to avoid 1 Police Officer of any type.

powers.name: Shadow
powers.title: The Muscle
powers.text: You may stack up 2 Locker or Exit tiles on a single Item space. You may not replace any tiles.

powers.name: Da Silva
powers.title: The Inside Man
powers.text: Each time you get income, gain an additional $3k. All costs are increased by $1k.

powers.name: Lady T.
powers.title: The Fixer
powers.text: You can refresh Fixer tiles as if they were Equipment tiles. Each time you do this, pay $1k plus the cost of the Fixer tile.

powers.name: Mr. V
powers.title: The Mastermind
powers.text: When you visit a Safe House, instead of losing 1 Notoriety, you may choose to gain 1 Notoriety, or not lose any. If you do any of the above, take a Wound.

powers.name: Kitty
powers.title: Gang Member
powers.text: You begin the game in control of the Gangs from the starting City tile and $3k less. You may not hire Gangs.
